Recieving <arc/>Bolt Charge refills 10% of the magazine. Does not currently dissipate Heat for Heat Weapons.

Discharging <arc/>Bolt Charge refills 20% of the magazine. Dissipates 100% Heat on Heat Weapons. 

Works while stowed.

enhanced (
#e Increases the magazine refill amount.
